name: Emergency Assist Terms v1.0
terms:
IMPORTANT CUSTOMER NOTICE

Please read this Agreement before accepting a CareYogi service. Healthcare involves clinical judgment and cannot

guarantee a particular diagnosis, treatment response or outcome. If a healthcare professional considers that your

condition requires a higher level of care, you may be advised to attend a hospital, emergency facility, or other

appropriate provider.

If you believe you are experiencing a medical emergency, do not wait for a CareYogi appointment or

teleconsultation. Seek immediate emergency medical assistance.

If you have availed Emergency Assistance Service from CareYogi, emergency limitations are governed by the

separate CareYogi Emergency and Safety Acknowledgement.

1. PARTIES AND DEFINITIONS

1.1 Company. “CareYogi”, “we”, “us” or “Company” means Mriduvandan Health Tech Private Limited, doing business

under CareYogi trademarked brand and operating the CareYogi Digital Hospital platform.

Registered/Corporate Address: 5th Floor, Adilakshmi Square, Plot No 137, Old Mumbai Highway, Gachibowli,

Hyderabad, Telangana 500032

Customer Support:  9810918237

Email: info@careyogis.com

Website: https://www.careyogis.com.

Grievance Officer: Rohit Madhusudan, Chief Operating Officer, email: RohitM@careyogis.com, Ph: 9810614737

1.2 Platform. “Platform” means the CareYogi website, mobile applications, APIs, databases, software, user interfaces,

communication systems and other digital interfaces operated or authorised by CareYogi.

1.3 Customer. “Customer” means the individual who creates an account, purchases or arranges a service, or

otherwise accepts this Agreement.















22. ELECTRONIC ACCEPTANCE AND RECORD OF CONSENT

22.1 This Agreement may be accepted by checkbox, button, OTP-authenticated action, digital signature or another

approved electronic mechanism.

22.2 CareYogi may retain an electronic audit trail showing Agreement version, date/time, account identifier, consent

type and other technical information reasonably necessary to evidence acceptance, subject to applicable law and

the Privacy Notice.

22.3 Service-specific consent is captured when the relevant service is requested. Acceptance of the Master

Agreement is not intended as blanket informed consent to every future medical procedure.

22.4 The accepted version and applicable consent records may be made available through the Platform or another

appropriate channel.

23. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AND PLATFORM USE

The Platform, software, branding, content, design and proprietary materials are owned by or licensed to CareYogi.

Customers may use the Platform only for lawful, authorised healthcare purposes and may not copy, reverse

engineer, misuse or commercially exploit it except as permitted by law.

24. PLATFORM AVAILABILITY AND THIRD-PARTY TECHNOLOGY

24.1 CareYogi will use reasonable efforts to maintain the Platform but does not promise uninterrupted availability.

24.2 Remote services may depend on telecommunications networks, devices, cloud services and other third-party

technology.

24.3 CareYogi may suspend or modify Platform functionality for maintenance, security, safety, legal compliance or

other reasonable operational purposes.

25. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY

25.1 Nothing in this Agreement limits liability or responsibility to the extent prohibited by applicable law.

25.2 CareYogi is responsible for its own contractual obligations and services it directly undertakes to provide.

25.3 For independently delivered third-party professional services, the responsible Service Provider remains

responsible for its professional acts and omissions to the extent provided by law and the relevant arrangement.

25.4 CareYogi does not guarantee clinical outcomes, recovery, diagnosis, treatment response, hospital admission or

uninterrupted access to a particular provider.

25.5 Any service-specific limitation must be consistent with applicable consumer and healthcare law.



26. COMPLAINTS AND GRIEVANCE REDRESSAL

26.1 Customers may raise service, clinical, billing, provider, safety or platform complaints through CareYogi support

channels.

26.2 CareYogi will maintain an appropriate grievance mechanism and publish required contact details.

26.3 Clinical complaints may be reviewed with the responsible professional/provider in accordance with applicable

law.

26.4 Privacy/data complaints may also be raised using the Privacy Notice contact mechanism.

27. SUSPENSION OR TERMINATION

The Customer may stop using the Platform subject to outstanding payments, active services, subscriptions and law.

CareYogi may suspend or terminate access where reasonably necessary for safety, fraud prevention, non-payment,

misuse, unlawful activity, staff abuse, security, legal compliance or material breach. Termination does not affect

rights or obligations that should survive.

28. CHANGES TO THIS AGREEMENT

CareYogi may update this Agreement. The revised version will identify its effective date. Where a change materially

affects Customer rights or obligations, CareYogi will provide notice and, where required by law, obtain fresh

acceptance before the affected service continues. Continued use will not by itself be treated as acceptance of a

material change where affirmative acceptance is legally required.

29. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION

This Agreement is governed by the laws applicable in India. Subject to mandatory statutory rights, disputes may be

subject to the jurisdiction of courts at [Hyderabad, Telangana / other agreed jurisdiction]. Nothing prevents a

Customer from exercising a statutory right to approach a competent consumer, regulatory, judicial or other

authority.

30. GENERAL

If any provision is invalid or unenforceable, it will be modified or severed to the minimum extent necessary and the

remainder continues.

Failure to enforce a provision immediately does not waive the right to enforce it later.

Neither party is responsible for delay caused by circumstances beyond reasonable control, subject to applicable law.

This Agreement, the separate Privacy Notice, separate Emergency & Safety Acknowledgement, applicable service

policies and any additional provider/procedure consent form accepted for a particular service form the relevant

CareYogi customer framework.
